newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - FelCor rating raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - FelCor rating raised.

text.p: -- Everen Securities Inc said Friday it raised its intermediate term rating on FelCor Suite Hotels Inc to outperform from market performer.
-- The real estate investment trust said Thursday it would offer three million shares of its common stock, with proceeds to be used for acquiring interests in additional properties.
-- Valuation of the stock is compelling versus Patriot American Hospitality Inc and Starwood Lodging Trust, two other hotel operators, Everen said.
-- FelCor shares were down 1/8 at 35-1/2 Friday.
